reason: Was `CERN,company,cncf-gitdm-single`. qti.qualcomm.com is Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.; QTI is Qualcomm's own abbreviation and the domain is a subdomain of qualcomm.com. The two other Qualcomm subdomains in the map (oss.qualcomm.com, qca.qualcomm.com) already say Qualcomm, from the curated `patch` source. Reviewed 2026-09-20.

Was `Medidata,company,cncf-gitdm-single`. collibra.com is Collibra NV, the data-governance software company (Brussels and New York); Medidata Solutions is a clinical-trial software company whose own domain is mdsol.com, already in the map as `Medidata Solutions`. Measured impact on the published data before fixing: 0 of the 185 firm-bearing Parquets carry a person_domain matching collibra or a firm_raw/firm matching medidata, so no re-run is needed. It also retires the `Medidata -> Medidata Solutions` row in firm_canonical.csv, whose only map occurrence was this one. Reviewed 2026-09-20.
